title: Black Cherry Balm Dotcom & Mini Lip Line Lip Liner Pencil Makeup Gift Set
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A limited-edition duo featuring full-size Black Cherry Balm Dotcom and a mini Lip Line Hydrating Lip Liner in Black Cherry.

What Else You Need to Know: Black Cherry Balm Dotcom is a moisturizing lip balm. Black Cherry Lip Line is a medium-coverage lip pencil.

This Set Contains:
- 0.5oz/ 15 mL Black Cherry Balm Dotcom
- 0.03 oz/ 0.8 g Black Cherry Lip Line
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
For definition and long wear:
-Start with a clean, bare lip.
-Line lips with Lip Line.
-Top with Balm Dotcom, blurring and blending with the angled applicator and/or fingertip.

For bold color and long wear:
-Start with a clean, bare lip.
-Apply Lip Line to the entire lip.
-Top with Balm Dotcom and press lips together to blend.
Ingredients+
Black Cherry Lip Line:
Isododecane, Synthetic Fluorphlogopite, Synthetic Wax, Polybutene, Trimethylsiloxysilicate, Silica, Isoamyl Laurate, Sucrose Tetrastearate Triacetate, Hydrogenated Jojoba Oil, Cetearyl Behenate, Pentaerythrityl Tetra-di-t-butyl Hydroxyhydrocinnamate, Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Red 6 (CI 15850), Red 7 (CI 15850), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140), Blue 1 Lake (CI 42090).

Black Cherry Balm Dotcom:
Petrolatum, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Beeswax/Cera Alba/Cire d’Abeille, Lanolin, Flavor/Aroma, Theobroma Grandiflorum Seed Butter, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Bran Extract, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Extract, Rosmarinus Officinalis (Rosemary) Leaf Extract, Tocopheryl Acetate, Tocopherol, BHT, Stevia Rebaudiana Leaf/Stem Extract, Benzyl Benzoate, Limonene, Citral, Citronellol, Linalool, Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77499), Red 33 Lake (CI 17200), Red 27 Lake (CI 45410), Red 30 Lake (CI 73360), Yellow 6 Lake (CI 15985).
